Name: Growable Fiber
Author: ChillsEmporium
Description:
[b]Growable Stone – Stardew Valley Mod[/b][b]Overview[/b]This mod allows you to [b]grow stone as a crop[/b] in [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. You can [b]purchase stone seeds from Pierre's General Store[/b], and once planted, they take [b]4 days to grow[/b].
While the [i]1.5 “Complete Community Cleanup”[/i] task from Linus (via the special orders board) rewards players with the [b]Fiber Seeds[/b] recipe, those seeds cannot be purchased from a shop. Because of this, [b]Growable Stone[/b] remains a useful alternative—especially for players who prefer convenience or missed the quest.
[line][b]Planned Features[/b][list]
[*]Add support for [b]JojaMart[/b] in late-game progression (if not handled automatically).
[*]Continue refining the [b]artwork[/b] for the stone plant.
[/list][line][b]Installation Instructions[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Extract the Mod File[/b]
After downloading, extract the archive.

[*][b]Move to Mods Folder[/b]
Place the extracted folder named [b]Growable Stone[/b] into the following directory:
[code]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]

[*][b]Install Required Mods[/b]
This mod requires the following dependencies:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] – The main mod loader for Stardew Valley
[*][b]Json Assets[/b] – Enables custom crops and items
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b] – Required for underlying custom crop mechanics
[/list]To install:
[list]
[*]Extract the downloaded [code].zip[/code] files for [b]Json Assets[/b] and [b]SpaceCore[/b].
[*]Move their folders to your [code]Mods[/code] directory, just like you did with Growable Stone.
[*]For [b]SMAPI[/b], extract it and run the installer matching your game version.
[/list]A [b]video tutorial[/b] will be provided soon to guide you through the process.

[/list][line][b]Uninstallation[/b]To uninstall the mod, simply delete the [b]Growable Stone[/b] folder from your [code]Mods[/code] directory.
[line][b]Bug Reporting & Balancing[/b]If you run into any bugs or have feedback regarding balance or usability, please don’t hesitate to contact me. Community input is very helpful in making this mod better!
[line][b]Want to Contribute?[/b]If you’re an [b]artist[/b] or [b]coder[/b] and would like to collaborate, feel free to reach out! I have many more mods planned and welcome any help or ideas.
[line][b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Json Assets
[*]SpaceCore
[/list][line][b]Tools Used[/b][list]
[*]Visual Studio 2022

[*]GIMP
[/list][line][b]Credits[/b][list]
[*][b]Markchill[/b] – Mod concept, coding, and artwork for the stone plant
[*][b]ErosDkAi[/b] – Creator of the original seed sprite (from the [i]Growable Ore[/i] mod) and kindly allowed its use in this project
[/list][line][b]Support the Mod[/b]If you enjoy this mod and would like to support its development, donations are greatly appreciated. Thank you for downloading and testing the mod!
